item.text: {"search_note":"I did **not** find reliable 2023 evidence that Putin clearly restrained Wagner, other proxies, or arms recipients from atrocities, or that he accepted responsibility for their foreseeable conduct. The record instead shows a mix of plausible deniability, continued patronage, and only narrow crisis containment during the mutiny itself.","evidence":[{"title":"Russia's Putin says he let mutiny continue to avoid bloodshed","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"26 Jun 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russias-putin-says-he-let-mutiny-continue-to-avoid-bloodshed-3113594","summary":"Putin said he deliberately allowed the Wagner mutiny to run its course to avoid bloodshed, and claimed the episode reinforced national unity. This is the strongest pro-restraint item, but it is narrow crisis management rather than evidence that he restrained Wagner from atrocities or accepted responsibility for foreseeable proxy conduct.","question_ids":["2B.5","1B.8"]},{"title":"Putin's comment on funding Wagner shows link to Ukraine -prosecutor","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"3 Jul 2023","url":"https://theprint.in/world/putins-comment-on-funding-wagner-shows-link-to-ukraine-prosecutor/1652212/","summary":"Putin publicly said Wagner and Yevgeny Prigozhin had received almost $2 billion from Russia in the previous year. That is direct evidence of Kremlin support for a proxy force whose conduct was being scrutinized for war crimes, and it undercuts any claim that he distanced himself from foreseeable proxy abuses.","question_ids":["2B.5","2B.2"]},{"title":"UN experts seek probe into possible war crimes by Mali, Russia's Wagner","publisher":"Euronews, reporting Reuters","date":"1 Feb 2023","url":"https://www.euronews.com/2023/02/01/mali-security-un","summary":"UN experts cited persistent reports of executions, mass graves, torture, rape, pillaging, arbitrary detention, and enforced disappearance by Malian forces and Wagner-linked fighters. The article also notes Putin had previously denied the Russian state had anything to do with Russian military contractors in Mali, which points away from accepting responsibility for foreseeable proxy conduct.","question_ids":["2B.5","2B.2"]},{"title":"US asks what's next for Russia's Wagner in Middle East, Africa","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"28 Jun 2023","url":"https://theprint.in/world/us-asks-whats-next-for-russias-wagner-in-middle-east-africa/1646778/","summary":"The report says Wagner had become central to conflicts in Mali and the Central African Republic, and that observers worried about the group’s future after the mutiny. This reinforces that Wagner was functioning as a destabilizing proxy network, with no clear sign that Putin had imposed a corrective restraint regime.","question_ids":["2B.5","2B.2"]}]}
